items.text: Commanders QB Jayden Daniels underwent imaging on dislocated left elbow; will consult experts. Marcus Mariota expected to start Sunday vs Seattle. Last similar injury cost ~4 weeks/month.
items.why: Dislocated left elbow (recurrence); X-rays negative for fracture; further testing/protocol.
items.implication: Mariota starts; WAS offense less dynamic, impacts all pass catchers.
items.opportunity: Potential short-term boost or change for McLaurin/Samuel/Diggs usage under Mariota.

items.text: Bears HC Ben Johnson expects Caleb Williams to be week-to-week with left hamstring injury after MRI; will likely miss some time. Same hamstring injured in college. Tyson Bagent is the backup.
items.why: Hamstring pull on scramble; MRI Monday; coach comments on ESPN1000.
items.implication: Bagent starts upcoming games; monitor CHI pass catchers/RBs for volume shifts.
items.opportunity: Backup QB opportunity; potential boost to Swift/Odunze/Burden/Loveland targets/carries.

items.text: Ladd McConkey officially ACTIVE (cracked rib, flak jacket possible). RJ Harvey inactive (hamstring); grab Jonah Coleman if available.
items.why: Official active list confirmation; prior ETR/Rap optimism.
items.implication: McConkey plays with possible docks; Harvey out opens DEN RB snaps.
items.opportunity: Coleman (handcuff) elevated role; McConkey still startable with injury risk.

items.text: Puka Nacua (hip) true game-time decision for MNF. McConkey optimism (projected in with docks); Harvey not expected; Olave/Burrow expected; Flowers/Pittman OUT.
items.why: Weekend reports summary; Levitan notes Rap bullish on McConkey.
items.implication: Nacua uncertain (trending wrong per later reports); Flowers out boosts others.
items.opportunity: If Nacua out: Adams/others; Flowers out: Bateman etc.

items.text: Packers WR Jayden Reed injured his back Sunday; spent night in NJ, returning to GB; team evaluating treatment/recovery timeframe. Earlier ruled out (neck).
items.why: Source report on back injury post-neck ruling.
items.implication: Miss time possible; GB WR committee shifts (Watson/Wicks).
items.opportunity: Boost to Christian Watson/Dontayvion Wicks targets.

items.text: Bucky Irving separating from Kenny Gainwell: 51-23 snaps, 17-2 carries, 22-12 routes yesterday. Through 2 weeks opportunities 36-12. Tucker active but 0 snaps.
items.implication: Irving emerging as clear lead back in TB; Gainwell diminished.
items.opportunity: High snap/route share; strong RB2/flex with goal-line upside.

items.text: Rhamondre Stevenson lost another fumble (7th in 31 games) and was punished with playing time. NE needs TreVeyon Henderson explosiveness often, especially with AJ Brown out.
items.why: Fumble punishment + weapon-deficient offense + Brown absence.
items.implication: Henderson role expansion even without more Stevenson fumbles.

items.text: DeVonta Smith RIDE OR DIE. Target shares 27%/38% first two games; leading all WRs in expected PPR points per model.
items.why: High target share + expected points leadership.
items.implication: Must-start WR1/2; heavy usage in PHI offense.
items.opportunity: Elite target share/routes; strong weekly floor/ceiling.

items.text: Eagles RB Saquon Barkley will have MRI after stinger; hope it is minor. He played through it after early exit and return with neck roll.
items.why: Stinger on first play; returned and played; MRI for caution.
items.implication: Likely available soon; monitor for Week 3.
items.opportunity: If limited, Bigsby/Shipley (not listed) get work; Goedert also knee MRI concern.

items.text: 49ers WR Mike Evans hip injury not believed serious by HC Shanahan; could have returned in 4th if needed. Demarcus Robinson high ankle sprain.
items.implication: Evans expected back soon; SF WR depth hit by Robinson.

items.text: Sunday injuries watching: Caleb Williams (ham), Jayden Daniels (elbow), Saquon Barkley (stinger), Jayden Reed (head), Mike Evans (hip not serious), Dallas Goedert (knee), JK Dobbins (ham), Jonathon Brooks (groin), others.
items.implication: Multiple key players status TBD via MRI/imaging Monday.
items.opportunity: Handcuffs/backups elevated short-term (e.g. for Dobbins, Brooks, Goedert).

items.text: Zay Flowers (hamstring) OUT; Michael Pittman (foot) OUT. Expect look at Germie Bernard with Pittman out.
items.opportunity: Bateman/others for Flowers; Bernard for Pittman.

items.text: Charlie Kolar (arm) left after 42 snaps; David Njoku (knee) after 11. Allowed Orande Gadsden 29/67 snaps and 15 routes on 31 Herbert dropbacks.
items.implication: Gadsden (not listed) temporary TE opportunity in LAC.
items.opportunity: Routes on dropbacks if Njoku/Kolar miss time.

items.text: Marvin Harrison Jr. down to 0.53 yards per route run this season. Only a few WRs worse (incl. Quentin Johnston at 0.48).
items.implication: Efficiency concerns despite targets; monitor role/volume.
items.opportunity: Low YPRR signals limited upside unless volume spikes.
